text: A POI tab replaces the IMU tab (IMU tab removed entirely): one unified list of POIs including photos, each with a button that centres it on the map and opens a popup.
Map markers coloured by POI kind and areas by zone; photo triangles smaller.
The agent's job tasks (phases) shown as a dropdown.
Responsive overhaul of the whole web UI for desktop, tablet and mobile.
The agent places POIs reliably: persistence across sessions, auto stuck points, nudges in tool results, one turn-end POI review, and a Map marking prompt section (D8a-e).

An Arm tab: gripper and overview cameras, arm-glued 3D views, a jog panel (cartesian and joint steps, gripper), Take control / Release / Home, and leader teleop restored through a dedicated bridge (D9a-e).

Generous agent job limits with a timer per task: set_task_plan declares a time budget instead of a fixed 15-minute timer, higher caps, repeatable budget raises, budget and time left in the web UI job header (D10a-c).
